---
title: "Timelines and Resolution Analysis"
format: html
---

## Setup

```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(here)
library(cowplot)
library(ggnewscale)

# Source project-specific themes and palettes
source(here("R", "theme_config.R"))
```

## Data Preparation

```{r data-prep}
df_raw <- read_excel(here("agri_data_review.xlsx"), sheet = "Sorted")

df_agri <- df_raw |>
  filter(focus == "agriculture") |>
  mutate(
    dataType = case_when(
      dataType == "shp" ~ "vector",
      TRUE ~ dataType
    ),
    Category = factor(category, levels = c(
      "Combined Agroecosystem", "Crops", "Grassland", "Livestock",
      "Intensity & Management", "Fertilizer", "Pesticide"
    ))
  ) |>
  filter(dataType %in% c("raster", "vector"))
```

## Composition: Barplots & Timeline

```{r plot-composition, fig.height=18, fig.width=16}
# 1. Combined Dodged & Stacked Barplot
df_summary <- df_agri |>
  filter(!is.na(Category)) |>
  count(continent, Category)

extent_levels <- levels(fct_infreq(df_agri$continent))

df_summary <- df_summary |>
  mutate(x_plot = factor(continent, levels = extent_levels))

p_combined_bar <- ggplot(df_summary, aes(x = as.numeric(x_plot), y = n)) +
  geom_col(aes(fill = Category), width = 0.6, color = "white", linewidth = 0.5) +
  scale_fill_category() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = 1:length(extent_levels), labels = extent_levels) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0.05))) +
  labs(x = "Continent", y = "Number of Datasets") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 20, hjust = 0.6, size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length.y = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 10))
  )

# 2. Timeline Plots
df_events <- data.frame(
  Year = c(1961, 1972, 2015),
  Label = c("FAOSTAT", "Landsat", "Sentinel-2")
)

df_timeline_snapshot <- df_agri |>
  filter(!is.na(temporalStart) & !is.na(temporalEnd)) |>
  mutate(
    timespan = temporalEnd - temporalStart,
    is_timeseries = if_else(timespan > 0, "Time Series", "Static Snapshot")
  ) |>
  filter(is_timeseries == "Static Snapshot") |>
  arrange(Category, desc(temporalStart)) |>
  mutate(
    plotStart = if_else(temporalStart < 1950, 1950, temporalStart),
    nameShort = fct_rev(fct_inorder(nameShort))
  )

p_timeline_snapshot <- ggplot(df_timeline_snapshot, aes(y = nameShort)) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = 1987.5, width = 75, fill = Category)) +
  geom_point(aes(x = plotStart, shape = dataType), color = "#333333", fill = "white", size = 3) +
  scale_fill_category() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("raster" = 15, "vector" = 22), name = "Data Type") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1950, 2025)) +
  geom_vline(data = df_events, aes(xintercept = Year), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = df_events, aes(x = Year - 1, y = -Inf, label = Label), angle = 90, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1, color = "darkred", size = 4.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1950, 2025, by = 5),
    labels = ~ if_else(.x %% 10 == 0, as.character(.x), ""),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Dataset Name", title = "Static Snapshots") +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(4, "pt"),
    strip.text.y = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank()
  )

df_timeline <- df_agri |>
  filter(!is.na(temporalStart) & !is.na(temporalEnd)) |>
  mutate(
    timespan = temporalEnd - temporalStart,
    is_timeseries = if_else(timespan > 0, "Time Series", "Static Snapshot")
  ) |>
  filter(is_timeseries == "Time Series") |>
  arrange(Category, desc(temporalStart)) |>
  mutate(nameShort = fct_rev(fct_inorder(nameShort))) |>
  mutate(
    plotStart = if_else(temporalStart < 1950, 1950, temporalStart),
    plotEnd = if_else(temporalEnd > 2025, 2025, temporalEnd),
    arrow_type = case_when(
      temporalStart < 1950 & temporalEnd > 2025 ~ "both",
      temporalStart < 1950 ~ "first",
      temporalEnd > 2025 ~ "last",
      TRUE ~ "none"
    )
  )

p_timeline_series <- ggplot(df_timeline, aes(y = nameShort)) +
  geom_tile(aes(x = 1987.5, width = 75, fill = Category)) +
  geom_segment(
    data = ~ filter(.x, arrow_type == "none" & timespan > 0),
    aes(x = plotStart, xend = plotEnd, yend = nameShort), linetype = "solid", color = "#333333", linewidth = 1.5
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = ~ filter(.x, arrow_type == "first"),
    aes(x = plotStart, xend = plotEnd, yend = nameShort), linetype = "solid", color = "#333333", linewidth = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), ends = "first", type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = ~ filter(.x, arrow_type == "last"),
    aes(x = plotStart, xend = plotEnd, yend = nameShort), linetype = "solid", color = "#333333", linewidth = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), ends = "last", type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_segment(
    data = ~ filter(.x, arrow_type == "both"),
    aes(x = plotStart, xend = plotEnd, yend = nameShort), linetype = "solid", color = "#333333", linewidth = 1.5,
    arrow = arrow(length = unit(0.1, "inches"), ends = "both", type = "closed")
  ) +
  geom_point(aes(x = (plotStart + plotEnd) / 2, shape = dataType), color = "#333333", fill = "white", size = 2) +
  scale_fill_category() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("raster" = 15, "vector" = 22), name = "Data Type", guide = guide_legend(order = 3)) +
  scale_y_discrete(position = "right") +
  coord_cartesian(xlim = c(1950, 2025)) +
  geom_vline(data = df_events, aes(xintercept = Year), linetype = "dashed", color = "darkred", alpha = 0.5) +
  geom_text(data = df_events, aes(x = Year - 1, y = -Inf, label = Label), angle = 90, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1, color = "darkred", size = 4.5, inherit.aes = FALSE) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = seq(1950, 2025, by = 5),
    labels = ~ if_else(.x %% 10 == 0, as.character(.x), ""),
    expand = c(0, 0)
  ) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Dataset Name", linetype = "Data Type", fill = "Category", title = "   Time Series") +
  facet_grid(Category ~ ., scales = "free_y", space = "free_y", switch = "y") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(b = 5)),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12, color = "black"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title.x = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold", margin = margin(t = 10)),
    axis.line.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length.x = unit(4, "pt"),
    strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    strip.placement = "outside"
  )

# 3. Prepare Scatterplot for Panel A
df_scatter <- df_agri |>
  mutate(timespan = temporalEnd - temporalStart) |>
  filter(timespan <= 100, !is.na(timespan), !is.na(resolutionKm)) |>
  mutate(plot_timespan = if_else(timespan == 0, 0.5, as.numeric(timespan)))

p_scatter <- ggplot(df_scatter, aes(x = plot_timespan, y = resolutionKm, color = Category, shape = dataType)) +
  geom_point(size = 3.5, alpha = 0.8, fill = "white") +
  scale_color_category() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("raster" = 15, "vector" = 22), name = "Data Type") +
  scale_x_log10(breaks = c(0.5, 1, 5, 10, 20, 50, 100), labels = c("Snapshot", "1", "5", "10", "20", "50", "100")) +
  scale_y_log10(
    breaks = c(0.01, 0.03, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 5, 10, 50, 100, 600),
    labels = c("10m", "30m", "100m", "250m", "500m", "1km", "5km", "10km", "50km", "100km", "per-country")
  ) +
  annotation_logticks(sides = "l") +
  labs(x = "Timespan in years", y = "Spatial grain") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "grey90"),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

# Extract shared legend
n_cat <- max(length(category_colors), 2)
dummy_col1 <- data.frame(
  x = rep(1, n_cat), y = rep(1, n_cat),
  fill_cat = factor(rep(names(category_colors), length.out = n_cat), levels = names(category_colors)),
  dtype = factor(rep(c("raster", "vector"), length.out = n_cat), levels = c("raster", "vector"))
)

p_leg_col1 <- ggplot(dummy_col1) +
  geom_col(aes(x, y, fill = fill_cat)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = 1, xend = 2, y = 1, yend = 1), linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1.5, color = "#333333") +
  geom_point(aes(x = 1.5, y = 1, shape = dtype), size = 3, color = "#333333", fill = "white") +
  scale_fill_category() +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c("raster" = 15, "vector" = 22), name = "Data Type", drop = FALSE, guide = guide_legend(order = 2)) +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    legend.justification = c(0, 1),
    legend.box = "vertical",
    legend.margin = margin(t = 0),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 13),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 15, face = "bold"),
    legend.key.size = unit(1.3, "lines")
  )

shared_legend <- cowplot::get_legend(p_leg_col1)

# Clean individual plots of legends
p_scatter_clean           <- p_scatter
p_combined_bar_clean      <- p_combined_bar + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_timeline_series_clean   <- p_timeline_series + theme(legend.position = "none")
p_timeline_snapshot_clean <- p_timeline_snapshot + theme(legend.position = "none")

# Layout parameters
scatter_x <- 0.02; scatter_y <- 0.55; scatter_w <- 0.40; scatter_h <- 0.40
bar_x     <- 0.44; bar_y     <- 0.55; bar_w     <- 0.36; bar_h     <- 0.40
leg_x     <- 0.81; leg_y     <- 0.55; leg_w     <- 0.18; leg_h     <- 0.40
snap_x    <- 0.02; snap_y    <- 0.00; snap_w    <- 0.40; snap_h    <- 0.52
ts_x      <- 0.44; ts_y      <- 0.00; ts_w      <- 0.54; ts_h      <- 0.52

combined_plot <- ggdraw() +
  draw_plot(p_scatter_clean, x = scatter_x, y = scatter_y, width = scatter_w, height = scatter_h) +
  draw_plot_label("a", x = 0.02, y = scatter_y + scatter_h, size = 24, fontface = "bold") +
  draw_plot(p_combined_bar_clean, x = bar_x, y = bar_y, width = bar_w, height = bar_h) +
  draw_plot_label("b", x = bar_x, y = bar_y + bar_h, size = 24, fontface = "bold") +
  draw_plot(shared_legend, x = leg_x, y = leg_y, width = leg_w, height = leg_h) +
  draw_plot(p_timeline_snapshot_clean, x = snap_x, y = snap_y, width = snap_w, height = snap_h) +
  draw_plot_label("c", x = snap_x, y = snap_y + snap_h, size = 24, fontface = "bold") +
  draw_plot(p_timeline_series_clean, x = ts_x, y = ts_y, width = ts_w, height = ts_h) +
  draw_plot_label("d", x = ts_x, y = ts_y + ts_h, size = 24, fontface = "bold")

combined_plot
```

## Save Figure Outputs

```{r save-timelines-plot}
dir.create(here("outputs", "figures"), recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

ggsave(
  filename = here("outputs", "figures", "fig_timelines_and_resolution.svg"),
  plot = combined_plot, width = 16, height = 20
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("outputs", "figures", "fig_timelines_and_resolution.eps"),
  plot = combined_plot, width = 16, height = 20, device = cairo_ps
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("outputs", "figures", "fig_timelines_and_resolution.pdf"),
  plot = combined_plot, width = 16, height = 20, device = cairo_pdf
)

ggsave(
  filename = here("outputs", "figures", "fig_timelines_and_resolution.png"),
  plot = combined_plot, width = 16, height = 18, bg = "white"
)
```

## Manuscript Figure Statistics

```{r manuscript-stats}
library(knitr)

general_format_stats <- df_agri |>
  count(dataType, name = "Count") |>
  mutate(Percentage = round((Count / sum(Count)) * 100, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(Count))
kable(general_format_stats, caption = "General Overview: Dataset Formats (Raster vs Vector)")

general_spatial_stats <- df_agri |>
  count(continent, name = "Count") |>
  mutate(Percentage = round((Count / sum(Count)) * 100, 1)) |>
  arrange(desc(Count))
kable(general_spatial_stats, caption = "General Overview: Dataset Distribution by Continent")

panel_b_each <- df_summary |>
  group_by(continent) |>
  mutate(Total = sum(n), Percentage = round((n / Total) * 100, 1)) |>
  ungroup()

panel_b_total <- df_summary |>
  group_by(Category) |>
  summarise(n = sum(n), .groups = "drop") |>
  mutate(continent = "All Continents Combined", Total = sum(n), Percentage = round((n / Total) * 100, 1))

panel_b_stats <- bind_rows(panel_b_each, panel_b_total) |>
  arrange(continent == "All Continents Combined", continent, desc(n))

kable(panel_b_stats, caption = "Panel B: Dataset Distribution by Continent")

panel_c_stats <- df_timeline_snapshot |>
  summarise(
    `Total Snapshots` = n(),
    `Raster Count` = sum(dataType == "raster"),
    `Vector Count` = sum(dataType == "vector"),
    `Oldest Snapshot Year` = min(temporalStart, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Newest Snapshot Year` = max(temporalEnd, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable(panel_c_stats, caption = "Panel C: Static Snapshot Summary Statistics")

panel_d_stats <- df_timeline |>
  summarise(
    `Total Time Series` = n(),
    `Mean Duration (years)` = round(mean(timespan, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    `Median Duration (years)` = median(timespan, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Oldest Start Year` = min(temporalStart, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Newest End Year` = max(temporalEnd, na.rm = TRUE),
    `Datasets Extending Past 2025` = sum(temporalEnd > 2025, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
kable(panel_d_stats, caption = "Panel D: Time Series Summary Statistics")
```

## Supplemental Boxplot

```{r plot-boxplot, fig.width=8, fig.height=6}
df_boxplot <- df_agri |>
  filter(dataType == "raster" & !is.na(temporalStart) & !is.na(temporalEnd)) |>
  filter(temporalStart >= 1900 & temporalEnd <= 2026) |>
  mutate(
    duration = temporalEnd - temporalStart + 1,
    Timespan = case_when(
      duration > 10 ~ ">10 years",
      duration >= 3 & duration <= 10 ~ "3-10 years",
      duration >= 1 & duration < 3 ~ "1-3 years",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  ) |>
  filter(!is.na(Timespan)) |>
  mutate(Timespan = factor(Timespan, levels = c(">10 years", "3-10 years", "1-3 years")))

p_boxplot <- ggplot(df_boxplot, aes(x = Timespan, y = resolutionKm)) +
  geom_boxplot(fill = "#e0e0e0", color = "black", outlier.shape = 21, outlier.fill = "white") +
  scale_y_log10(labels = function(x) format(x, scientific = FALSE, drop0trailing = TRUE)) +
  labs(x = "Timespan", y = "Resolution (km)") +
  theme_publication() +
  theme(
    axis.line = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.ticks.length = unit(4, "pt"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 13, color = "black"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 15, hjust = .6, face = "bold"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(angle = 90, margin = margin(r = 10)),
    plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 20, l = 10)
  )

p_boxplot

ggsave(
  here("outputs", "figures", "supplemental_boxplot.png"),
  p_boxplot, width = 8, height = 6, bg = "white"
)
```
